transcript.text: I reviewed the current employee roster and state-law matrix this week and confirmed that exactly 620 Illinois employees will be enrolled in the voice-authentication system. Illinois biometric law requires written opt-in consent before collecting their voiceprints and also requires the company to publish a retention schedule.
